rule: docs/TREE_PLAN.md: one yard tree for every two or three houses, in back yards and at lot corners, never against a fence or a wall (zone 813 -> about 400)
written: by hand, 19 Nov 2026 (cloud session, the city-wide superchecker run from the bottom of the list). The quadrant's fourteen builder trees go (eucalyptus, ficus, magnolias and jacarandas along the back fences, three magnolias 2.7-3 m from the houses); five come back on their own spots, about one for every two houses: by a swing set, on the open lot corner, and in three back yards 6-10 m from the houses.

trees.why: the back yard with the swing set (2.8 m off): a young eucalyptus over the swings
the open lot corner at the south-west, 24 m from the walls: a full jacaranda
the south back lot line, 10 m from the houses: a magnolia between two yards
the east back yard of the north row, 7 m from the house
the west back yard of the north row, 6 m from the house, 71 m from the next
